title: 第40章 屈辱离别第41章 出世之路
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
南宫秋月给赵宇喂完大还丹，把赵宇搂在怀中，嘴里仍不停地喊着：“赵宇，赵宇，你千万要挺住啊，一定不能死，不能死！”
话到后边，竟变成了不停念叨。
她只要看到赵宇脸上有血，便用袖子慢慢擦去。
这时，呆在一边的陈妈大脑一片混乱，这到底怎么回事？南宫秋月自小起，她就一直跟着了，没有发现小姐认识什么男子，特别是关系亲近的男子，包括与南宫家族有关系的家族子弟，宗门子弟。
她更没有见过这个还是少年的男子。
看来所发生的事情也就这几天的事情，这几天到底发生了什么事情？他百思不得其解。
而且看到南宫秋月如此在乎那男孩，两人的关系一定极不简单！
她又细细地看了南宫秋月一会，凭她的修为和经验是可以看得很清楚的。
内心感概，还好两个人还未越轨，顿时松了一口气。
看着南宫秋月一脸的悲痛和愤怒，她也不敢去问这问那，只能在一边忐忑不安！
南宫秋月抽搐一会，见赵宇仍未醒转，转过头来，双眼通红盯着陈妈，暴怒问道：“你跟他有什么大仇？他杀你父母亲人了？还是害你了？你要如此伤害他？”
陈妈听着南宫秋月冰冷又愤怒的一连串问话，再次心惊！
她也不知如何回答，只是不着边际回答道：“我，我看他在小姐身边，怕他伤害到你，所以…”
看着陈妈的狡辩，南宫秋月更是恼怒：“他伤害我？他一直在身边，何时伤害过我？”
“我看他拉着小姐的手，是不怀好意”
，陈妈又回了一句。
“哼！”
南宫秋月一声怒哼：“他拉着我的手就是要伤害我？我告诉你不是他拉我的手，是我拉他的手。”
“小姐，你可是万金之躯，岂能被一个山野小子玷污？”
陈妈又似找到什么理由回答道。

南宫秋月从小聪慧敏觉，知书达礼，身在豪门大族见过大世面，也撑得起大场面，言辞问答该犀利自然犀利！
虽年纪不大，已有大家风范。
也就这几天在赵宇身边，不知为何出现一副小女子的娇娇样。
她横了陈妈一眼，仍无一丝好脸色：“我是万金之躯，别人看不得、碰不得？别人都是臭鱼烂虾，想打就打，想杀就杀？那你又是什么身份？”
此言一出，陈妈听完简直是五雷轰顶，小姐怎么连这样的绝情话都说了出来！
就差两人直接翻脸了。
实则也是她自己活该！
世间多有这样的人，对上位者、强者一如既往的奉承、献谄，而对所谓的下面之人、弱者就凶残冷酷，这次给南宫秋月呵斥，实属自找。
南宫秋月没有理会陈妈的惊恐，继续说道：“你多大年纪了？你什么境界，什么修为？竟然对一个只有十多岁的少年痛下杀手，你还有没有羞耻之心？”
陈妈现在已是无言以对，虽回想起觉得有些过分，但仍无悔改之心，受南宫秋月呵斥，也只能忍着，她从小就在南宫家长大，她的那点境界和修为在南宫家也就和那些门卫相同，喽蚁而已。
她又转眼看向赵宇，内心对赵宇更是憎恨！
心想今日之耻都是由这小子而起。
南宫秋月仍在不依不饶：“陈妈，我告诉你，今日赵宇若出什么大事，你以后就别跟着我了，想去哪儿就去哪儿吧。”
陈妈一阵悲苦，心想真是女大不中留啊！
为了一个刚认识的小子，以前情同母女的小姐竟然如此的翻脸无情，可悲啊！
而她就是没有去反思自己。
她想了一会还是忍不住问道：“小姐，我到现在一直无法理解小姐为什么要这样对待我？难道你我十多年的情谊还比不上一个小姐刚认识的人？还有这几天究竟发生了什么？小姐能告诉我吗？”
此时，南宫秋月的情绪稍微平复了一些，本不想回复陈妈的疑问，想了想，还是很冷漠地回答道：“前几日我被妖兽所伤，几近死亡，是赵宇赵公子救我回来的，他是我的救命恩人。
content_en:
After Nangong Qiuyue fed Zhao Yu the Dahuan Dan, she held Zhao Yu in her arms and kept shouting: "Zhao Yu, Zhao Yu, you must hold on, you must not die, you must not die!"
Afterwards, the words turned into constant talking.
Whenever she saw blood on Zhao Yu's face, she would slowly wipe it off with her sleeves.
At this time, Chen’s mother, who was standing aside, was in a state of confusion. What on earth was going on? She has been following Nangong Qiuyue since she was a child. She has not found out that the young lady knows any men, especially men with close relationships, including family children and sect children who are related to the Nangong family.
She had never seen this young man before.
It seems that what happened is only the past few days. What happened in the past few days? He was puzzled.
And seeing that Nangong Qiuyue cares so much about the boy, the relationship between the two must be extremely complicated!
She looked at Nangong Qiuyue carefully for a while, and she could see clearly based on her cultivation and experience.
I felt in my heart that fortunately the two of them hadn't gone off the rails yet, and they breathed a sigh of relief.
Seeing the grief and anger on Nangong Qiuyue's face, she didn't dare to ask about this or that, so she could only stay uneasy on the side!
Nangong Qiuyue twitched for a while, and seeing that Zhao Yu still didn't wake up, she turned around, stared at Chen's mother with red eyes, and asked angrily: "What's the big grudge between you and him? Did he kill your parents and relatives? Or did he hurt you? Do you want to hurt him like this?"
Listening to Nangong Qiuyue's series of cold and angry questions, Chen's mother was frightened again!
She didn't know how to answer, so she just answered vaguely: "I, I saw that he was next to the lady, and I was afraid that he would hurt you, so..."
Seeing Chen Ma's sophistry, Nangong Qiuyue was even more angry: "He hurt me? He has always been around, when has he ever hurt me?"
"I think he held the lady's hand with evil intentions."
, Chen Ma replied again.
"Hmph!"
Nangong Qiuyue snorted angrily: "He held my hand just to hurt me? Let me tell you, he didn't hold my hand, it was me who held his."
"Miss, you have a body of ten thousand gold, how can you be defiled by a mountain boy?"
Mother Chen seemed to have found some reason and replied.
Nangong Qiuyue has been smart and perceptive since she was a child. She is well-informed and courteous. She belongs to a wealthy family and has seen a lot of things in the world. She can also support big events. Her words and questions should be sharp and natural!
Although he is young, he already has the demeanor of everyone.
In the past few days, around Zhao Yu, for some reason he looked like a little girl.
She glanced at Chen's mother, but she still didn't look good at all: "I am a person with a wealth of money. Others can't see or touch me? Others are just rotten fish. They can be beaten and killed whenever they want? Then what is your identity?"
As soon as these words came out, Chen Ma was shocked. How could the young lady even say such heartless words?
All it took was for the two of them to fall out.
In fact, she deserves it!
There are many people like this in the world, who flatter and flatter the superiors and the strong as always, but are cruel and cruel to the so-called inferiors and the weak. This time, Nangong Qiuyue scolded her, and she really asked for it.
Nangong Qiuyue ignored Chen Ma's panic and continued: "How old are you? What is your realm and cultivation level? You actually killed a boy who was only more than ten years old. Do you still have any sense of shame?"
Chen Ma was speechless now. Although she thought it was a bit excessive in retrospect, she still had no intention of repenting. She was scolded by Nangong Qiuyue, so she could only endure it. She had grown up in Nangong's family since she was a child. Her level and cultivation in Nangong's family were the same as those of the doormen, just ants.
She turned to look at Zhao Yu again, hating Zhao Yu even more in her heart!
I thought that today's shame was all caused by this kid.
Nangong Qiuyue was still reluctant: "Mother Chen, let me tell you, if something big happens to Zhao Yu today, don't follow me anymore. Go wherever you want."
Mother Chen felt miserable for a while, thinking that it was really not a good place for women to stay in college!
For a boy I just met,The young lady who used to love her mother and daughter turned out to be so heartless. How sad!
And she just didn't reflect on herself.
After thinking for a while, she couldn't help but ask: "Miss, I still can't understand why the lady treats me like this? Could it be that the friendship between you and me for more than ten years is not as good as a person whom the lady just met? And what happened in the past few days? Can the lady tell me?"
At this time, Nangong Qiuyue's mood calmed down a little. She didn't want to reply to Chen Ma's question, but after thinking about it, she still replied coldly: "I was injured by a monster a few days ago and almost died. It was Mr. Zhao Yu who rescued me. He is my savior.
